title: Hazard-interrupted pass commitment on a Classic planner
description: Two consecutive 5 Hz intents from a classic_planner participant on a 10 m section at Rookie difficulty, matching the referenced observation obs.t000500.ai_classic_2 (a clear 10 m straight). The first intent commits to a right-side pass (commitment_raw 0.5, executed_label commit_pass starting at tick 500) and per-tick safety overrides the commands at tick 506 when the lead car moves left and closes the passing room. The second intent, 12 ticks later, records the hazard interruption: the executed commitment ends after 12 ticks (0.2 s), before the 0.4 s minimum, which is legal only because interrupted is true with a reason. This is the counterpart to the held commitment in fixture.intent.surge_commit_pass: a commitment may be held past the proposal, and it may be ended early only by a hazard. The second record's source_observation_id (obs.t000512.ai_classic_2) is an illustrative reference to an observation record that is not shipped as an observation fixture, so only this fixture's first record has a participant/tick pairing that can be verified against the observation slice; the ID follows the observation contract's obs.t<tick>.<participant> convention and nothing further is claimed about it.

lateral.note: Corridor half-width is (10.0 - 1.7)/2 - 0.5 m = 3.65 m; 0.6 x 3.65 m = 2.19 m, legal with no correction.

commitment.label: commit_pass
commitment.note: 0.5 is above the +1/3 commit threshold; the commitment starts at this intent's generated_tick 500.

drift.label: grip
drift.note: Below -0.25, so the preference is grip.

interventions.note: Per-tick safety overrode the commands at tick 506 when the lead car moved left into the passing room; the 5 Hz intent fields themselves needed no correction.

lateral.note: 0.3 x 3.65 m = 1.095 m, back toward the racing line; legal with no correction.

commitment.label: wait
commitment.interruption_reason: the lead car moved left at tick 506 and closed the passing room; the hazard ended the pass commitment after 12 ticks, before the 0.4 s minimum
commitment.note: 12 ticks (0.2 s) since the commit at tick 500, inside the 0.4 s minimum; the release is legal only because a hazard interrupted it.

expectations.statement: The decoded lateral target equals the raw decode 2.19 m and stays inside the corridor.
The interrupted intent's decode 1.095 m is also consistent.
A commitment that starts at a record matches that record's threshold decode and begins at its generated_tick 500.
The commitment is released after 12 ticks (0.2 s), before the 0.4 s minimum, which is legal only because interrupted is true and interruption_reason names the hazard.
commitment_raw 0.0 decodes to wait and drift_raw -0.5 decodes to grip.
drift_raw -0.5 decodes outside the retain band, so the executed preference is grip.
The single per-tick override tick 506 lies inside the first intent's hold window [500, 512) and is ascending and distinct.
A hazard interruption is not an emergency substitution: substituted stays false with a null kind, tick and reason and persistent false.
The rookie speed-profile interval is null (unratified until M4.3), so no target speed is determined and no pace correction may appear.
Consecutive intents are 12 ticks apart at the 5 Hz tactical rate on a 60 Hz tick.
intent_age_ticks equals sampled_tick minus generated_tick.
The interrupted intent's age arithmetic is consistent.
Rookie difficulty uses the 18-tick delayed traffic snapshot.
The second intent carries the same Rookie traffic age.
Record difficulty, style, producer kind and revision match the fixture context; Classic-only style is 'none'.
The second record also matches the fixture context.
Hazard checks are never deferred while a tactical intent is held.

The first intent's source observation obs.t000500.ai_classic_2 resolves and agrees on participant, tick, difficulty, style, traffic age, reset generation, history validity, route frame and road width.
The second intent's source observation is declared illustrative because the observation slice ships no such record.
The intent carries the 0.4 s minimum commitment constant.
Every declared metric is a documented initial target or an explicit undecided requirement; no fixture metric claims a measured status.
Each metric's bound members match its comparator: threshold comparators carry value, range/ratio_range carry ordered value_min/value_max, report carries no bound.
Every null that means 'not yet determined' has a matching unknowns entry.

unknowns.reason: The rookie desired speed-profile interval is tuned at M4.3 and is not numerically specified.
Target speed cannot be decoded until the difficulty interval is ratified.
The short anti-jitter commitment window length is not numerically specified.
Same unratified window length as records.0.
The interpolation curve is not specified.
Placeholder only: no Classic planner revision exists until M4.2 implements the shared interface.
Required behavior for a stale intent (at or beyond 12 ticks) is not specified.

The hold window [generated_tick, generated_tick + period_ticks) is this contract's modeling decision for tick-level safety exposure; OPPONENT_AI.md does not say whether a record exported at sampled_tick inside the window must truncate its intervention list.

The emergency kind vocabulary (emergency_stop, reset, classic_fallback) is provisional until the intervention categories are preregistered before evaluation (OPPONENT_AI.md 'Implementation and acceptance'); the metric itself is a later measured run.
